drivingQuestion: Is it a rule that individual offerings may be male or female?
outcomeNote: The answer comes in the next unit

segments.he: קׇרְבְּנוֹת הַיָּחִיד נוֹהֲגוֹת בֵּין בִּזְכָרִים בֵּין בִּנְקֵבוֹת. וּכְלָלָא הוּא? וַהֲרֵי עוֹלָה, דְּקׇרְבַּן יָחִיד, וְזָכָר אָתְיָא, נְקֵבָה לָא אָתְיָא!
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «Offerings of an individual apply to,» i.e., can be brought from, «both males and females.» The Gemara asks: «Is» this an established «principle,» that all offerings of an individual may be brought from either a male or female animal? «But» what about «a burnt offering, which is an offering of an individual, and» yet it «comes» as «a male» animal but does «not come» as «a female» animal.
